extracted.intended_audience: published creative writers in the United States considering applying for NEA Creative Writing Fellowships (prose for FY2026)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for preparing and submitting an application for the National Endowment for the Arts Creative Writing Fellowships (prose in FY2026), including eligibility, required materials, review criteria, deadlines, and post-award obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary review criteria — artistic excellence and artistic merit
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are reviewed through an anonymous process in which the primary criteria for review are the artistic excellence and artistic merit of the submitted writing sample.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The submitted writing sample is the central basis for judgment; applicants should select examples that best demonstrate high artistic quality. Because review is anonymous, do not include identifying information in the sample (see Application Instructions/Grant Program Details for guidance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Anonymous review process
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are reviewed through an anonymous process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare materials (especially the writing sample and any supporting documents) so they do not reveal the applicant's identity; follow any specific anonymity instructions in the Application Instructions document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — U.S. citizen or permanent resident
rubrics_metrics.description: Individual U.S. citizens or permanent residents of the U.S. who meet specific publication requirements are eligible to apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm your citizenship or residency status and any documentation requirements in the Grant Program Details before applying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — publication requirements (must be a published creative writer)
rubrics_metrics.description: The program offers fellowships to published creative writers; applicants must meet specific publication requirements (see Grant Program Details for the complete list).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review the Grant Program Details document for the exact publication thresholds, acceptable publication venues/formats, and how to document publications in your application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant type — individuals only; organizations ineligible
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding is not available in this category for organizations; this program funds individuals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only apply as an individual; institutional or organizational submissions are not accepted under this fellowship category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application limits — one application per individual; mutually exclusive with Translation Project in same year
rubrics_metrics.description: An individual may submit only one application for FY 2026 Literature Fellowships funding. You may not apply for both a Creative Writing Fellowship and a Translation Project in the same calendar year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the single application you will submit for the year and do not submit multiple NEA applications that conflict with this restriction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genre and cycle — fellowship subject depends on program year
rubrics_metrics.description: The program operates on a two-year cycle with fellowships in prose (fiction and creative nonfiction) and poetry available in alternating years. For FY 2026, fellowships in prose are available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply only in the year that matches your genre (e.g., prose applicants for FY2026). Poetry fellowships will be offered in the alternate year (FY2027).

rubrics_metrics.name: Required application materials and forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications require registration (Login.gov and Grants.gov), completing the Application for Federal Domestic Assistance—Individual form (SF-424), and creating additional required application materials as detailed in the Application Instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the step-by-step instructions in the Application Instructions PDF/Word document; gather all required materials early and ensure forms (including SF-424) are correctly completed and uploaded to the Grants.gov package.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration and submission process
rubrics_metrics.description: Register with Login.gov and Grants.gov (or renew/verify registrations) and submit the pre-populated application package in Grants.gov using the Funding Opportunity Number 2025NEA03LFCW.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allow time for account registration and verification with Login.gov/Grants.gov before the deadline. Use the pre-populated Grants.gov package linked from the NEA page and follow the Application Instructions for completing each attachment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadlines and timeline adherence
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications for Creative Writing Fellowships are accepted annually. For FY2026: Guidelines Posted mid December; Application Deadline March 12, 2025 11:59 pm ET; Panel Review Spring/Summer 2025; Notifications December 2025; Earliest Project Start Date January 1, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit by the stated deadline (March 12, 2025 11:59 pm ET for FY2026) and monitor the review/notification timeline. Late or incomplete applications are subject to rejection; follow timing instructions in Application Instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship award amount and permitted uses
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds are intended to enable recipients to set aside time for writing, research, travel, and general career advancement. Plan project timelines and budgets accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competitive/selectivity expectation
rubrics_metrics.description: Competition for fellowships is rigorous. NEA typically receives approximately 2,000 applications each year and awards fellowships to fewer than 2% of applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider carefully whether your work will be competitive at the national level before investing time in the application; use past recipient examples (see Literary Arts Impact) and the Grant Program Details to gauge fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-award management and reporting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Review reporting requirements and other information related to managing a federal award, including the General Terms and Conditions on the Manage Your Award page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If awarded, comply with NEA post-award reporting, financial management, and General Terms and Conditions; review these obligations in advance so you understand post-award responsibilities.
